summary: Rewrote oauth.rs with RFC 8414/OIDC discovery (issuer verification, HTTPS jwks_uri), standard claims (numeric sub, client_id, space-delimited scope), iat validation with 30s skew, bounded TTL caching with one-refresh-on-unknown-kid for key rotation. Added 9 Phase 3 integration tests validating real RSA-signed tokens against the auth-server claim contract.
follow_up: The one-refresh-on-unknown-kid path is exercised by the stale-key test (refresh happens, key still absent → reject). A dedicated positive refresh test (JWKS changes between first fetch and refresh) would require a stateful mock server; the key-rotation-overlap test covers the success case with both keys present.
important_context: TokenValidator is now the shared validator in AuthState; the free function validate_access_token creates a fresh validator per call (no shared cache) — production code uses AuthState.validator which shares caches across requests
The jwks_uri HTTPS check is conditional: enforced when issuer is HTTPS, relaxed for HTTP issuers (test environments)
scope claim is now a space-delimited string (standard OAuth), not a JSON array; the old namespaced claims (https://commoncal.tld/*) are no longer parsed
